 9-1-1, Grey’s Anatomy to air overnight Thursday due to Blues game 
 By First Alert 4 Staff Published : Oct. 19, 2026 at 10:25 AM CDT Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google ST. LOUIS, Mo. (First Alert 4) - ABC programming will shift to different times on Thursday due to the telecast of the St. Louis Blues game. 
 9-1-1 will air overnight Thursday (Friday morning, October 23) at 1:06 a.m. 
 9-1-1 Nashville will air overnight Thursday (Friday morning, October 23) at 2:06 a.m. 
 Grey’s Anatomy will air overnight Thursday (Friday morning, October 23) at 3:06 a.m. 
 The programs will also be available to stream on Hulu on Friday.
 Thursday night’s Blues game is the first of 10 games that will air on First Alert 4 on ABC in St. Louis this season. The team will take on the Las Vegas Golden Knights starting at 7 p.m. 
 Click here to add these Blues games to your calendar 
 St. Louis viewers and regional communities can access ABC across all major broadcast, cable, satellite, and streaming platforms: 
 Over-the-Air (Antenna): Channel 32.1 
 Spectrum Cable: Channel 12 
 Dish Network/DIRECTV/AT&T U-verse: Channel 30 
 CableOne (Expected Channel Numbers): Rolla, MO: KMOV-DT2 (ABC) Ch. 18 
 Sullivan, MO: KMOV-DT2 (ABC) Ch. 17

 Greenville, IL: KMOV-DT2 (ABC) Ch. 10
